title: Apple and orange bircher with hazelnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, milk, oranges, sultanas, apples, Greek yoghurt, hazelnuts, honey and cinnamon are all plain home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, hazelnuts included, is an everyday item at Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a grater and a knife and board, with no technique beyond grating and slicing.

works.reason: 200g oats soaked in 300ml milk plus the juice of two oranges, then loosened with yoghurt and two grated apples, makes a sensible texture and amount for four.

honest_times.reason: Zesting, juicing, grating, slicing and chopping fit within 15 active minutes, and the 480 minutes is an honest overnight soak.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon appear in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored apples are still good in mid-April, and with four apples grated in and sliced on top they are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, like a neighbour explaining it.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, fruit, yoghurt and nuts make a filling, wholesome breakfast with only a modest drizzle of honey.
